[Official website](https://www.alexmackayco.com/)

## How I would choose between them

For your particular requirements, I would contact **Estate First Lawyers, Cornford-Scott Lawyers and Fit Lawyers** first: the first two are in Toowong and have relevant estate-planning credentials, while Fit Lawyers offers a convenient Centenary-area location.

When comparing them, ask each firm\:

1. **Testamentary trusts\:** Can you draft a discretionary testamentary trust will, and explain the tax, asset-protection and administrative trade-offs?
2. **Enduring powers of attorney\:** Can you prepare Queensland-compliant enduring powers of attorney covering financial and personal matters, with appropriate safeguards?
3. **Whole-of-estate planning\:** Will you review jointly owned property, superannuation death-benefit nominations, existing family trusts and company interests alongside the will?
4. **Fees\:** What is the total fixed fee for a will with a testamentary trust, an enduring power of attorney and any advance health directive, including revisions and signing?
5. **Experience\:** Who will personally advise you, and what relevant succession-law qualifications or specialist recognition do they hold?

You can also use the [Queensland Law Society's specialist accreditation directory](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation) to check for a solicitor accredited in succession law. [www.qls.com.au](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.legalaid.qld.gov.au](https://www.legalaid.qld.gov.au/Find-legal-information/Personal-rights-and-safety/Taking-care-of-other-peoples-affairs/Wills-and-deceased-estates?lang_update=639222640274869629&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important distinction\:** a testamentary trust is not automatically the best option for every family. It can provide flexibility and potential tax or asset-protection advantages, but it also adds ongoing administration and cost. A good solicitor should explain when it is worthwhile for your circumstances.

## How I would choose between them

For your particular requirements, I would contact **Estate First Lawyers, Cornford-Scott Lawyers and Fit Lawyers** first: the first two are in Toowong and have relevant estate-planning credentials, while Fit Lawyers offers a convenient Centenary-area location.

When comparing them, ask each firm\:

1. **Testamentary trusts\:** Can you draft a discretionary testamentary trust will, and explain the tax, asset-protection and administrative trade-offs?
2. **Enduring powers of attorney\:** Can you prepare Queensland-compliant enduring powers of attorney covering financial and personal matters, with appropriate safeguards?
3. **Whole-of-estate planning\:** Will you review jointly owned property, superannuation death-benefit nominations, existing family trusts and company interests alongside the will?
4. **Fees\:** What is the total fixed fee for a will with a testamentary trust, an enduring power of attorney and any advance health directive, including revisions and signing?
5. **Experience\:** Who will personally advise you, and what relevant succession-law qualifications or specialist recognition do they hold?

You can also use the [Queensland Law Society's specialist accreditation directory](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation) to check for a solicitor accredited in succession law. [www.qls.com.au](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.legalaid.qld.gov.au](https://www.legalaid.qld.gov.au/Find-legal-information/Personal-rights-and-safety/Taking-care-of-other-peoples-affairs/Wills-and-deceased-estates?lang_update=639222640274869629&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important distinction\:** a testamentary trust is not automatically the best option for every family. It can provide flexibility and potential tax or asset-protection advantages, but it also adds ongoing administration and cost. A good solicitor should explain when it is worthwhile for your circumstances.
